scope: Zero-API inspection of the official public repositories and model metadata. No benchmark inference, scorer execution, or paid judge call was performed.

ESC-Role.architecture_surface: eight safetensor shards plus tokenizer/config files

ESC-RANK.surface: language-specific PEFT adapters for seven dimensions plus checkpoints and tokenizer copies
ESC-RANK.metadata_warning: The model page reports that root config.json is invalid JSON.

code_findings: evaluate.py hard-codes Qwen1.5-7B and Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct candidate paths and five dialogue rounds; it is not a generic frozen runner for Llama 3.1 8B.
score.py depends on InternLM2-chat-7B and PEFT adapters but no package versions or base-model revision are pinned.
score.py loads the fluency adapter from ./ESC-RANK1/fluency while the other adapters use ./ESC-RANK, so the published tree cannot run unchanged at that point.
The repository has no license file and no requirements, environment, setup, or pyproject lock surface.
The public data contain all 655 high-quality role cards reported by the paper, but no train/dev/test split manifest for candidate qualification.
ESC-Eval.allowed_use_now: Pin protocol, role-card identity, construct, and published reference distribution; build a local wrapper and calibration before treating any score as a pass decision.
ESC-Eval.forbidden_use_now: Do not call a score produced by the unmodified repository a qualified generator pass.

code_findings: The repository publishes 100 roles in roles-v1.json but does not publish the frozen identity of the 25 roles used in the paper.
The README pins o1-mini for the comparison example, while code defaults are mixed across o1-mini and o4-mini.
multidim_merge_and_judge.py uses temperature 1.0, filesystem file order, and one A/B orientation per pair; no paired A/B swap or position-bias aggregation is implemented.
The simulation script fixes 14 alternating turns in code, while run scripts do not freeze seeds or a dependency environment.
No requirements, environment, setup, or pyproject dependency lock is present.
ESC-Judge.allowed_use_now: Use E-I-A as a sensitivity construct after locally freezing roles, candidate/reference generation, symmetric ordering, tie/invalid handling, model snapshot, and human anchors.
ESC-Judge.forbidden_use_now: Do not describe a new run as exact paper replication or use it as the sole absolute generator pass.

ES-MemEval.issue_search_result: No public repository issue or git history entry explains or identifies the final-paper 1209-row QA subset.
ES-MemEval.allowed_use_now: Run and name the public v1.0.0 1427-row task as a distinct artifact, or wait for authoritative 1209 IDs.
ES-MemEval.forbidden_use_now: Do not call the 1427-row public task or the historical 418-row project slice an exact reproduction of the final-paper 1209 QA set.

decision: Recognized benchmarks remain central, but recognition does not waive local measurement qualification. P0 exits only after an executable wrapper, identity manifest, calibration or sensitivity evidence, and claim boundary are frozen.
external_contact_boundary: No issue, email, or author contact was sent. A request for final ES-MemEval 1209 row IDs remains a possible later action requiring separate authorization.
